deadline.q: How long does a project take?
deadline.a: It depends on scope: websites usually take 2–4 weeks and systems 6–12. The detailed schedule comes with the proposal.

payment.a: Usually 50% on approval and 50% on delivery, by card, bank transfer or Pix. Larger projects can be split into milestones.

ownership.a: Yes. At the end, the source code, credentials and documentation are 100% yours.

scope.q: What if the scope changes midway?
scope.a: Changes are welcome: we assess the impact on time and cost and record everything before moving on.

maintenance.q: Do you offer maintenance after delivery?
maintenance.a: Yes. Besides the bug-fix warranty, you can hire the Ongoing partnership or ad-hoc support.

cancel.q: Can I cancel the Ongoing partnership?
cancel.a: Yes, with 30 days' notice and no penalty. You keep everything delivered.

lgpd.q: How are sensitive and health data handled?
lgpd.a: With LGPD (Brazil's data protection law) in mind: access control, encryption, audit logs and data minimization. I never use real data in demos.

invoice.a: Yes, every project comes with a contract and an invoice.
